What is the ratio of the number of students who scored 40 and above in Hindi to the number of students who scored 20 and above in English
solution:
**Calculation:**

The number of students who scored 40 and above in Hindi = 80

The number of students who scored 20 and above in English = 180

The ratio will be:

⇒ 80 : 180

⇒ 4 : 9

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
